list: The official 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden until earned), as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles before launch, cross-checked 2026-11-19. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written for this app and cites its sources.
onlineNote: No trophy in the official launch list needs online play: every one of the 55 is earned in single player, and the two 'partner' trophies mean the second protagonist, not another player. Launch lists agree on this, so the Online filter is honestly empty.

roadmap.advice: Play the opening and start a manual save at the chapter's start: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Before the chapter ends, follow Lucia when she goes out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate (a morning after the mission Down to Earth) and accept the optional task — that moment feeds Positive Mental Attitude and is gone once Chapter 1 ends. Beat Cal at fishing and finish an arcade game while you are here.
roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — Arrive in Leonida

roadmap.advice: Breakfast Run unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia, and calling the other in as your partner. Rob Kingpin Bowling with Sticky Bombs, buy the eight garages once the Vice City Real Estate app opens (after Daily Driver), and start registering cars through the Scooter Bros app (after Moses) — every registered car needs a free garage space.
roadmap.title: Chapter 2 — Two leads, one map

roadmap.advice: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 hands you the Snap Gun: rob a jewelry store unseen for Sneakthief, and chain three shop robberies with your partner for Retail Therapy. Run Race Against Yago the moment its hourglass icon appears — that Strangers & Freaks strand is time-sensitive.
roadmap.title: Middle chapters — The robbery toolkit

roadmap.advice: Clear the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4 to unlock bank vaults. A single vault escape with your partner makes progress on Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and Hot Together at once — trophies settle once you have left the red heat zone.
roadmap.title: Late chapters — Vaults and heat

roadmap.advice: Keep one untouched manual save from just before the final mission. Everything outside the story — side-story finales, free-roam trophies and the 100% checklist — stays available after the credits, so the finale is not a point of no return for the list as a whole.
roadmap.title: The finale

roadmap.advice: Finish the six side-story finales (Andy's strand is Lucia-only; Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only) and complete eight Strangers & Freaks strands — remembering that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count toward the eight. Check the Strangers & Freaks progress counter after each strand.
roadmap.title: Side stories & strangers

roadmap.advice: Sweep the challenge, crime and stunt lists: the VCIA boarding-bridge jet, the Mile Zero tank, five kills in one Combat Focus, one illegal operation per gang, and the collectible hunts. The five cryptic hidden trophies may pop along the way; their triggers were still unconfirmed at launch, so do not burn hours forcing them.
roadmap.title: Free-roam Leonida

roadmap.advice: Close out the counters the 100% checklist demands — 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all eight vaults, every card set — until A Long Road pops and the platinum follows. Launch guides estimate roughly 200 hours. Never use cheats on this save: cheats switch off trophies and saving.
roadmap.title: The long road to 100%

trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Budget for the long haul — launch guides estimate roughly 200 hours, most of it the 100% completion checklist behind A Long Road. Nothing about the platinum itself is missable; protect the run with the save habits in the roadmap and never use cheats on your trophy save.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. Every story trophy is unmissable as you play the campaign, but there is no mission replay, so start a manual save at the beginning of Chapter 1 before you settle in.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene, so don't worry if it lands a few minutes late. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — that moment disappears afterwards.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens just after Breakfast Run early in this chapter, which is what unlocks the partner trophies and most of the map's side content.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where the robbery toolkit arrives — jewelry jobs with the Snap Gun — and where the time-sensitive Race Against Yago strand appears. Do that race the moment it shows up.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Bank vaults open near the end of this chapter through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, so clear that before pushing into the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it: there is no mission replay or New Game Plus, and that save is your safety net for anything you still owe the list.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Right after it, switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, and you can call the other character in as your partner for the partner trophies.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A straight story beat: play the campaign and it pops. The chapter-save habit still applies — there is no way to replay it later.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable on the campaign path; it pops as the mission completes.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Unmissable on the campaign path; it pops as the mission completes.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable on the campaign path — and a reminder that the airport stays useful later, for the boarding-bridge jet behind Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable on the campaign path; it pops as the mission completes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you do earlier still counts toward it. It asks for more than the trophy list in places — 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicles, all eight bank vaults — so treat the other grinds as part of this one. Launch estimates put the full platinum at roughly 200 hours.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total. Keep going past 250 if you are chasing 100% — that checklist wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once: races, fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, meditation and the rest. It is a sampler trophy — most activity types unlock as the chapters open the map up, so sweep this up whenever a new icon type appears.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the game's two shooting ranges. Learn one weapon class at a time and replay a challenge while its target patterns are still fresh; golds here are about consistency, not speed.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in all. You only need one win per location, so learn each course with a practice run first, then race it clean.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeating the same race does not add to the count. Work through the race icons on the map. The time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is a strand race, so grab it the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. It is available early — launch checklists put it in Chapter 1 — and makes a gentle first activity trophy: take the challenge when Cal offers it and land your catches steadily rather than rushing the reel.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four in-game arcade games and finishing any single one of them counts, so pick whichever you find first — an easy Chapter 1 tick.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — its final mission is this trophy. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, and side-story finales stay available after the credits, so it is not missable. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand. Side-story finales remain open after the story ends, so work through Kenton's jobs whenever they suit you.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand. Like the other side-story finales it stays available after the credits. Billy's strand has its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count here — so check this trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One strand is a trap: Race Against Yago, a Chapter 3 street-racing strand marked with an hourglass icon, is time-sensitive; do it the moment it appears.
trophies.missableNote: One strand feeding this trophy is time-sensitive: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, hourglass icon). Do it the moment it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand. Randy's finale stays available after the credits, like the other side-story endings.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only and stays open after the story; it carries its own trophy, so it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating at an outdoor spot with your partner along may count for both characters. This trophy carries the one real missable risk in the whole list: in Chapter 1, after Lucia is home (a morning after the mission Down to Earth), she meditates on the balcony of Jason's house — follow her out and accept the optional task, because the moment disappears when Chapter 1 ends. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that spot, but every major launch guide flags it: do it anyway, and keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears when Chapter 1 ends — the one missable moment every launch guide flags.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and works through target decks that send you after specific animals; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The questline stays available after the credits.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are a collectible hunt spread across Leonida: sweep them up as you explore each region rather than leaving one full-map card run for the end, and finish whichever sets are nearly complete first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Make it a habit: whenever you arrive somewhere new, scan the spot — the same habit that builds Whip It Good when you scan vehicles.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, tracked under Progress > Challenges. Many of them complete on their own as you play. If you are chasing 100% you will need 70 of the 80, so glance at the list late-game and mop up the nearly-done ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner called in, earn a 4-star Wanted Level and lose it completely. Bank vault jobs hand you 4 stars on the spot, so escaping one alongside your partner earns this naturally — and remember, trophies like this pop only once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner in, then rob 3 shops back-to-back without your Wanted Level dropping. Keep the heat alive between shops: if the stars fade and you are only left in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so don't rob a fourth while you wait.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive instead of hunting rare spawns. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim (press L3 + R3 while aiming). Line the group up first — the guards at a gang's illegal operation are ideal — use an assault rifle, and remember that adrenaline extends Focus.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count; the jets at gates E3 and E4 work. Take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport; the trophy is delayed and pops mid-flight. Save first, because the police respond fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — means getting into a Rhino military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, then drive and fire until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry robberies: use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm and ruins the attempt. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and slip out unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if anyone spots you, reload and retry rather than pushing on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored van to a large bank and slip into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the bags alone — and expect an instant 4-star Wanted Level; the escape only counts once you have left the red heat zone. There are eight vaults in all, and 100% completion wants every one.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored vans are tied to the bank-vault unlock late in Chapter 4; rob one, then lose the heat completely — the trophy settles once you are out of the red heat zone, not merely out of sight.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. This one is about coverage, not collectibles: cross every region of the state as you work through the story and side content, then check the map late-game for any corner you never crossed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Variety is the whole job: one operation per gang, not nine of the same one. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations robbed, so this pops along the way if you are completion-hunting.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — this is one of five hidden trophies whose trigger no guide has verified yet. The official description, 'Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach', is the only real hint, and it may simply pop during normal play. If you experiment, Ocean Beach is the place the description names; treat anything more specific as unconfirmed until launch guides verify it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The description — smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom 'in classic style' — points at escaping through a showroom in a vehicle, but the exact setup is unverified and it may pop in normal play. Treat specific claimed methods as rumours until guides confirm them.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so this one is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The cryptic description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is about strength: get both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner called in; your partner trains alongside you, so both characters build Strength together.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The description says 'Choices made (for better or worse)'; launch guides report the real counter underneath it: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up on its own over a normal playthrough — no separate grind needed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests a second-chance event, and one launch guide reports it as exactly that: a hidden second-chance trigger whose precise method is still unverified. Play normally and don't burn hours trying to force it until guides confirm the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch — 'What the hell just happened?' is all anyone has to go on, and no guide has verified a trigger yet. It may pop during normal play; treat any specific claimed method as unverified until launch guides confirm it.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The description — 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by' — points at knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, but the exact setup is unverified. Don't grind it until guides confirm precisely what counts.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them on to your contacts to launder them. The total is cumulative, so it accrues across the whole playthrough rather than needing one big score.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The counter is cumulative across every kind of shop, and the big purchases elsewhere on the list — the eight garages alone cost about $160,000 — carry you straight past it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and garages the story gives you do not count. Buy these before registering vehicles — every registered car needs a free garage space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars at a Pay 'n' Spray fitted with a standard tracker. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
